Data model

<table>   DB: ... because ...
  id PK, ...FK, fields
  Index: (...) → for which query
  Shard key: ...

SQL: related data that must be right
Wide-column: huge append-only writes
Big files → object storage
Hot data → cache
Temporary → Redis with expiry
